meanings.en: unfair support shown to one person or group, especially by someone in authority
meanings.exampleEn: The manager was accused of favoritism for always promoting his friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür sürekli arkadaşlarını terfi ettirdiği için kayırmacılıkla suçlandı.

meanings.en: in a way that is possible to do or achieve
meanings.exampleEn: We need to work out how the project can feasibly be completed on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Projenin zamanında nasıl uygulanabilir şekilde tamamlanabileceğini çözmemiz gerekiyor.

meanings.en: raw material used to supply or fuel a machine or industrial process
meanings.exampleEn: Crude oil is the main feedstock for many petrochemical plants.
meanings.exampleTr: Ham petrol, birçok petrokimya tesisinin ana hammaddesidir.

meanings.en: to cut down a tree
meanings.exampleEn: They had to fell several old oak trees to build the road.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolu yapmak için birkaç yaşlı meşe ağacını kesmek zorunda kaldılar.

meanings.en: past tense of 'fall'
meanings.exampleEn: She slipped and fell on the icy pavement.
meanings.exampleTr: Buzlu kaldırımda kaydı ve düştü.

meanings.en: past tense of 'fell'; cut down or knocked to the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The storm felled dozens of trees across the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına bölgede onlarca ağacı devirdi.

meanings.en: a person who is a citizen of the same country as you
meanings.exampleEn: He urged his fellow citizens to vote in the upcoming election.
meanings.exampleTr: Vatandaşlarını yaklaşan seçimde oy kullanmaya çağırdı.

meanings.en: land that is able to produce good crops and plants
meanings.exampleEn: The valley is known for its fertile land and rich harvests.
meanings.exampleTr: Vadi, verimli toprağı ve bol hasadıyla tanınır.

meanings.en: the ability to produce offspring, or the quality of soil being able to produce good crops
meanings.exampleEn: Doctors ran tests to check the couple's fertility.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar çiftin doğurganlığını kontrol etmek için testler yaptı.

meanings.en: a thin thread of a natural or artificial substance, or the part of plants eaten for digestion
meanings.exampleEn: Whole grains are a good source of dietary fibre.
meanings.exampleTr: Tam tahıllar iyi bir lif kaynağıdır.

meanings.en: unable to stay still, especially because of boredom or nervousness
meanings.exampleEn: The children grew fidgety during the long ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar uzun tören boyunca kıpır kıpır oldular.

meanings.en: full of strong emotion such as anger or passion; like fire
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a fiery speech that stirred the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalığı coşturan ateşli bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: the number 15
meanings.exampleEn: There are fifteen students in my English class.
meanings.exampleTr: İngilizce sınıfımda on beş öğrenci var.

meanings.en: the number 50
meanings.exampleEn: The book costs fifty dollars.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap elli dolar tutuyor.

meanings.en: a fast military aircraft designed for combat
meanings.exampleEn: Two fighter jets flew low over the city during the parade.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçit töreni sırasında iki savaş uçağı şehrin üzerinden alçaktan geçti.

meanings.en: a competitive sport involving combat between opponents, such as boxing or wrestling
meanings.exampleEn: Boxing is a fighting sport that requires great discipline.
meanings.exampleTr: Boks, büyük disiplin gerektiren bir dövüş sporudur.

meanings.en: to steal something, especially something of small value
meanings.exampleEn: He would often filch snacks from the office kitchen.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofis mutfağından sık sık atıştırmalık aşırırdı.

meanings.en: the result that is produced at the end of a process or event
meanings.exampleEn: Nobody could predict the final outcome of the negotiations.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzakerelerin nihai sonucunu kimse tahmin edemedi.

meanings.en: a product that is complete and ready to be sold or used
meanings.exampleEn: Raw materials are turned into a finished product on the assembly line.
meanings.exampleTr: Ham maddeler montaj hattında bitmiş ürüne dönüştürülür.

meanings.en: the quality of having limits or an end
meanings.exampleEn: The poem reflects on the finiteness of human life.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir, insan yaşamının sonluluğu üzerine düşünür.

meanings.en: the area next to a fireplace, associated with warmth and comfort
meanings.exampleEn: They spent the winter evenings by the fireside reading books.
meanings.exampleTr: Kış akşamlarını şömine başında kitap okuyarak geçirdiler.

meanings.en: a sudden and violent outburst of anger or criticism, or a very intense fire
meanings.exampleEn: His controversial comments sparked a firestorm on social media.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışmalı yorumları sosyal medyada bir tepki fırtınası başlattı.

meanings.en: the sky or heavens, especially seen as a vault above the earth (literary)
meanings.exampleEn: The stars shone brightly across the firmament.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıldızlar gökkubbe boyunca parlak parlak ışıldıyordu.

meanings.en: fighting with the fists
meanings.exampleEn: The argument nearly ended in fisticuffs.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışma neredeyse yumruklaşmayla sonuçlanacaktı.

meanings.en: made to fit a particular shape or space closely
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a fitted jacket that showed off her figure.
meanings.exampleTr: Vücuduna oturan, figürünü gösteren bir ceket giymişti.

meanings.en: built to fit a specific space, as with furniture or kitchens
meanings.exampleEn: The house has a modern fitted kitchen.
meanings.exampleTr: Evde modern, gömme bir mutfak var.

meanings.en: the number 5
meanings.exampleEn: I have five brothers and sisters.
meanings.exampleTr: Beş kardeşim var.

meanings.en: water that contains bubbles of gas
meanings.exampleEn: Would you like still or fizzy water with your meal?
meanings.exampleTr: Yemeğinizle sade su mu yoksa gazlı su mu istersiniz?

meanings.en: clearly and openly bad or shocking; blatant
meanings.exampleEn: The decision was a flagrant violation of human rights.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar, insan haklarının apaçık bir ihlaliydi.

meanings.en: in an obvious and shocking way, without any attempt to hide it
meanings.exampleEn: They flagrantly ignored the safety rules.
meanings.exampleTr: Güvenlik kurallarını pervasızca görmezden geldiler.

meanings.en: a natural talent for something, or a stylish quality
meanings.exampleEn: She has a real flair for languages.
meanings.exampleTr: Dillere karşı gerçek bir yeteneği var.

meanings.en: to make something flat or flatter
meanings.exampleEn: Use a rolling pin to flatten the dough.
meanings.exampleTr: Hamuru düzleştirmek için bir oklava kullanın.

meanings.en: the process of becoming or making something flat
meanings.exampleEn: The flattening of the growth curve was a hopeful sign.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyüme eğrisinin düzleşmesi umut verici bir işaretti.

meanings.en: making someone seem more attractive or better than usual; expressing praise
meanings.exampleEn: That dress is very flattering on you.
meanings.exampleTr: O elbise sana çok yakışmış.

meanings.en: to show off something proudly to impress others
meanings.exampleEn: He loves to flaunt his wealth by driving expensive cars.
meanings.exampleTr: Pahalı arabalar kullanarak servetiyle hava atmayı çok sever.

meanings.en: the state of having no faults or imperfections
meanings.exampleEn: The flawlessness of her performance amazed the judges.
meanings.exampleTr: Performansının kusursuzluğu jüriyi hayran bıraktı.

meanings.en: the seed of the flax plant, often used as food or for oil
meanings.exampleEn: She sprinkled some flaxseed over her morning yogurt.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabah yoğurdunun üzerine biraz keten tohumu serpti.

meanings.en: the woolly coat of a sheep, or a soft warm fabric
meanings.exampleEn: He zipped up his fleece to keep warm in the cold.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğukta ısınmak için polarının fermuarını çekti.

meanings.en: the quality of lasting for only a very short time
meanings.exampleEn: The poem captures the fleetingness of youth.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir, gençliğin geçiciliğini yansıtır.

meanings.en: tending to change interests or feelings quickly; not serious or reliable
meanings.exampleEn: She was too flighty to hold down a steady job.
meanings.exampleTr: Düzenli bir işte tutunamayacak kadar maymun iştahlıydı.

meanings.en: the plants of a particular region or period
meanings.exampleEn: The island is famous for its unique flora and fauna.
meanings.exampleTr: Ada, kendine özgü bitki ve hayvan örtüsüyle ünlüdür.

meanings.en: a group of small ships or boats
meanings.exampleEn: A flotilla of fishing boats set out at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir balıkçı teknesi filosu şafakta denize açıldı.

meanings.en: to openly disobey a rule or law without hiding it
meanings.exampleEn: Many drivers flout the speed limit on this road.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yolda birçok sürücü hız sınırını hiçe sayar.

meanings.en: a change or variation, especially an irregular rise and fall in amount or value
meanings.exampleEn: Investors are worried about the fluctuation in oil prices.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatırımcılar petrol fiyatlarındaki dalgalanmadan endişe ediyor.

meanings.en: soft, light, and full of air or fur
meanings.exampleEn: The kitten had soft, fluffy fur.
meanings.exampleTr: Kedi yavrusunun yumuşak, kabarık tüyleri vardı.

meanings.en: nervous, confused, or upset, especially in a hurried situation
meanings.exampleEn: She got flustered when the interviewer asked an unexpected question.
meanings.exampleTr: Görüşmeci beklenmedik bir soru sorunca telaşlandı.

meanings.en: used to show the purpose or intended recipient of something
meanings.exampleEn: I bought this gift for my mother.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu hediyeyi annem için aldım.

meanings.en: used to show a period of time
meanings.exampleEn: We have lived here for ten years.
meanings.exampleTr: Burada on yıldır yaşıyoruz.
